name: uberasm-1up-or-code-at-certain-score-checkpoints-v1
title: 1UP (or code) at Certain Score Checkpoints V1.1
description:
This simple code grants the player an extra life at certain checkpoints in the score. More details in the .asm file.

Requested by LucasRCD.

Changelog
yoshifanatic's Update
- Made this compatible with asar 2.0.
- Fixed a bug where you wouldn't be given a reward unless all 3 score bytes were greater than the 3 current checkpoint score bytes (ie. 15,000 < 10,000 because the DC in #$05DC was less than the E8 in #$03E8).
- Changed the default reward code to one that spawns a 1-up score sprite instead of incrementing the life counter directly.
- Made this work for Luigi as well. Note that this requires an extra free RAM byte.

versions.title: 1UP (or code) at Certain Score Checkpoints V1.1

name: uberasm-add-color
title: Add Color 8 to Event Path Fade
description: This UberASM will fade color 8 in palette rows 4-7 during events in the same way as colors 1-7. This allows you to add an additional color to layer 2 tiles that fade in and out during event path fade.

versions.title: Add Color 8 to Event Path Fade

name: uberasm-airjump-with-jump-counter
title: Airjump with Jump Counter
description:
This is HammerBrother's Airjump uberASM code, but with a jump counter attached to the player that can count up to 9, or count down to 0, or just show infinity.

Credit is optional. Requested by 1UPdudes.

name: uberasm-always-wall-run
title: Always Wall-run
description:
Allows the player to wall-run on any wall at pretty much any time. No pink triangle needed!

Information on how to use can be found in "always_wallrun.asm" (the Uberasm file).

This is more or less the same code I used in zynnoir and I's KLDCX entry.

Note: Does not work properly with layer 2.

name: uberasm-automatic-alternating-jumps-v1
title: Automatic Alternating Jumps V1.1
description:
This makes the player alternate continuously between a normal jump and a spinjump.

yoshifanatic's update
- Made the sound effects configurable. Especially the jump sound, so it's easy to account for AddmusicK.
- Optimized the code a bit by utilizing tables.
- Added checks so the jump doesn't happen while in a lakitu cloud, P-Balloon, climbing, stunned, doing the victory pose, or while the game is paused.
- Made it so Mario displays the jump pose when doing the regular jump.
- Made it so the auto jump is more of an auto swim while underwater.

name: uberasm-basic-numerical-air-meter-v1
title: Basic Numerical Air Meter V1.1
description:
This simple piece of code places a numerical air meter on the status bar, effectively replacing the stars counter (protip: change the star graphics to a bubble or something for a better impact).

Quite customizable, and SA-1 hybrid.

yoshifanatic's update:
- Fixed an oversight where pausing on the frame the meter updates will cause it to update every frame. You'd also softlock if this happened while in water.
- Created a define that does the effect described in the comments for reversing the air meter.
- Made it so the air meter tile is initialized in init so it displays during the fade in instead of popping in right after.
- Made a few minor code optimizations.

name: uberasm-charged-fireball
title: Charged Fireball
description:
This UberASM makes mario shoot a Yoshi Fireball if you hold a fire button (and optionally an additional button, by default R), emulating a charged fireball, just like in many platformer games like Megaman.
Check out the ChargedFire.asm file for customization options.

It also includes a minor patch (to be applied with asar!) and GFX to make Yoshi Fireballs and Flopping Cheep-Cheeps swap tilemaps, so you can have Yoshi Fireballs in every level, optional but recommended (especially if using this in gamemode 14!).

You can find the patch version here.

name: uberasm-consistent-vanilla-walljumps
title: Consistent Vanilla Walljumps
description:
The walljump asm featured in KLDC 2021's entry #45 (Not Cataclysm). Now updated with layer 2 support and a customizable leniency for the walljump itself.

This walljump asm mimics the physics of the TAS-only walljumps that are frequently seen in pit hacks but makes them consistently performable for a human player. To be specific: Mario always clips the wall if he hits it with 29 or more horizontal speed while moving downwards and the window for the jump input has been increased from 1 to 5 frames (on default settings).

If you decide to use this, you should use a patch that disables the real vanilla walljumps as the player may get confused and frustrated otherwise.

This can be inserted per level or in gamemode 14.

name: uberasm-controller-read-optimization
title: Controller Read Optimization
description:
Saves a little NMI time by moving the controller read to the start of the game loop.

Use this if you need more NMI time to change blocks, exanimate, upload dynamic graphics, etc. Running out of NMI time may appear as broken gradients and a black bar at the top of the screen.

Be sure to use FastROM and 'Lunar Magic's "VRAM Patch" Optimization' in addition to this.

name: uberasm-counterbreak
title: Counterbreak
description:
This code allows you to reset various statuses and counters when the player returns to the overworld, including:
- Powerup
- Item box item
- Yoshi
- Coins
- Bonus stars
- Score
- Midway point
- Life count

To use, insert into game mode 0C.

Note: If you want to disable midpoints, this requires the "Bonus Game Midpoint Fix" patch to fix a vanilla quirk that will prevent events from running.

name: uberasm-credits-utilities
title: Credits Utilities
description:
This UberASM provides some useful (optional) functions for when the player reaches the credits (which can be either the vanilla credits cutscene, or a credits sublevel they're teleported to or whatever):
- Mark the final level as beaten and increase the exits count.
- Run a (silent) event that will show as already run next time the OW is loaded (post-credits stuff?).
- Open a direction on the OW from the current level (probably best used in conjunction with the silent event).
- Change the current player's OW position (teleport back to the start of the game, or to a new map, etc.)
- Save the game.

See the ASM file for more info.

name: uberasm-discoshell-on-off
title: Discoshell ON/OFF
description: Change shells to a discoshell with an on/off switch.

name: uberasm-dolphin-generator
title: Dolphin Generator
description:
This is a UberASM version of dolphin, left/right, generator, sprites CF and D0 in SMW.

Requested by RZRider.

name: uberasm-dynamic-radius-circle-window-v1-1
title: Dynamic Radius Circle Window v1.1.1
description:
This is basically a piece of code to draw a circle window with a given radius. Unlike the one that comes with Effect Tool, this one generates the circle on the run, not using a pre-computed table, allowing you to change the radius anytime you want.

The ASM file comes with some customizable options, such as whether the circle is centered at a fixed position or at Mario, the initial radius and some other stuff.

Notes: don't use it with message boxes, and make sure your level end isn't in the same level of this effect, otherwise stuff will look glitched up when you cross the goal tape or use the keyhole.

If not using the SA-1 patch, turn on the interlacing setting! Otherwise, this will likely cause lag.

Changelog
yoshifanatic's update
- Changed the encoding of CircleWindow.asm to UTF-8 so it'll work in asar 2.0.
- Made this LoROM compatible.
- Added a setting that enables interlacing to save on performance at the cost of making the circle look blurrier in motion. Enabling this is recommended if not using the SA-1 patch.
- Made the HDMA channel customizable.
- Fixed a bug where the circle would not initialize if you exit a sublevel and the circle draws at the exact same on screen position before in the next sublevel.

name: uberasm-dynamic-sprites-utility
title: Dynamic Sprites Utility
description:
A resource that enables dynamic sprites to be used.

Unlike the patch, this allows the graphics region used by dynamic sprites to be remapped (instead of always using the bottom half of SP4), bumps the limit of dynamic sprites on screen from four to six and includes a few other features. It's also generally more optimal and, aside from an option to uninstall the old patch, doesn't do any hijacks.

Refer to the readme (enclosed in the download or here) for more details and instructions on installing it and using the features!

NOTE: Dynamic sprites from the section will not be compatible with this: the conversions must be used instead.

name: uberasm-fade-from-title-screen-to-file-select-menu
title: Fade from Title Screen to File Select Menu
description:
This resource allows you to slowly transition from the title screen to the file select menu.

There's two files, one of which is meant to be inserted always in game modes 06 and 07, and another you optionally need to insert in game mode 03.

versions.title: Fade from Title Screen to File Select Menu
versions.filename: Fade From Title Screen to File Select Menu.zip

name: uberasm-fading-lights-v1-1
title: Fading Lights v1.1.2
description:
This UberASM will fade the brightness in the level in and out. There's two different modes available:
- Constant fading in/out based on a timer.
- Fade based on a certain switch. This can also be of two types: lights go back to bright when hitting a switch, but fade immediately to dark; or they only fade to dark when the switch goes off. Possible switches are: ON/OFF, blue POW, silver POW, red ? block.
In the file you can customize some parameters: how bright/dark the lights go and how long the fade will take.

v1.1:
- Doesn't use a dedicated HDMA channel anymore (smh).
- Uses 2 bytes of freeram instead of 7.
- Smaller code.

v1.1.1:
- Fixed a bug where this causes flashing during level end.

v1.1.2
- Fixed an underflow bug that caused the screen to turn black if !DarkValue was set lower than the default.

name: uberasm-graphical-air-meter-v2-0
title: Graphical Air Meter v2.0.2
description:
This is basically similar to the sprite version, but recoded from scratch, and more customizability. The amount of time the player can be in the water, unlike the sprite version, can be any value rather than restricted to powers of 2 "ticks" (which happens at every !CountDownFrequency+1 frames) starting at 255 units.

changelog
Code

   0; the maximum air value) into scratch RAM.
 - Added a new feature: InvertFill extra byte. When nonzero,
   the displayed meter fills up from empty as the player loses
   air rather than decreases from full.
2025-05-04 (v2.0.1) - text info update
 - Explained clearly about when later you need to change the

   that previously stated the wrong extra byte.
 - Placed a note in this readme explaining where the info
   about the extra bytes is in "Level_AirMeter.asm".
2025-04-11 (v2.0.1) - description update
 - Updated several graphical bar's write to HUD routine's
   description explaining that writing vertical bars routine

 - Did mention on the insertion process instructions about the

 - Explained more about sprite positioning in the defines.

name: uberasm-ground-pound-yoshi-s-stomp-effect
title: Ground Pound, Yoshi's Stomp Effect
description:
This UberASM allows player to perform a ground pound with a defined button. It acts like Yoshi's stomp upon landing.

Credit is optional. Requested by Batata Douce.

name: uberasm-horizontal-vertical-autoscroll
title: Horizontal/Vertical Autoscroll
description:
This code will enable horizontal or vertical autoscrolling in the level it's inserted in. Check out the asm file for customization options, such as scroll direction, speed/fractional speed and when to start and stop the autoscroll.

Note: when using horizontal autoscrolling with a high speed, Mario will die instead of being pushed by the border of the screen.

Note 2: usage of this patch is recommended to solve spawning issues when using this.

Update:
- Added horizontal autoscroll option.
- Added option to teleport when the autoscroll stops (suggested by TheMorganah).

name: uberasm-hurt-kill-on-sound-effect-trigger-v1
title: Hurt/Kill on Sound Effect Trigger V1.1
description:
Hurts or kills Mario when any sound effect starts playing (choose which option in the asm file).
Requested by Golden Yoshi.

yoshifanatic's Update:
- Made this use UberASMTool 2.0's end label to make this less janky.
- Added 3 tables that allow you to customize which sounds hurt/kill you. By default, the pause, time running out, the Yoshi drum commands, and AddmusicK's pause/echo commands don't hurt you.
- Made it so this UberASM doesn't run during level end or no Yoshi intros.

versions.title: Hurt/Kill on Sound Effect Trigger V1.1

name: uberasm-layer
title: Layer 2 Falls
description: This UberASM is basically a disassembly of the "Layer 2 Falls" sprite (sprite ED), with some customization options, such as speed, acceleration, movement direction (vertical up or down, horizontal left or right), etc. You can also change it to move layer 1 instead (basically acting as an autoscroller). With the default parameters it acts the same as the vanilla sprite.

name: uberasm-level-warp-display-v1-1
title: Level Warp Display v1.1.1
description:
An easy to configure level code for creating warp hubs.
It displays a custom text in the top left corner, switching between values when pressing left or right. Pushing A or B sends you to the designated level.
The text displayed, destination level and amount of levels can be easily changed, just add or remove values from the tables.

Useful for debugging or actual in game hubs.

Changelog
yoshifanatic's update:
- Made this asar 2.0 compatible.
- Made this compatible with vertical levels and Lunar Magic 3.00's horizontal level modes.
- Fixed an oversight where this will run during No-Yoshi intros.
- Made it so the code doesn't run when the game is paused.
- Made it so layer 3 is given priority so the text is always visible.
- Fixed an oversight where the secondary entrance macro didn't calculate the format for $19D8 correctly for secondary entrances greater than FF.

name: uberasm-lightning-generator-v1-0
title: Lightning Generator v1.0.1
description:
A visual generator which displays a lightning effect. It can be customised to write to any colour on the palette (it's 0 by default which affects the background) as well as customised in what colours the lightning will generate, how long it waits between each strike, etc.

Also included is a generator which can be inserted with PIXI if you prefer the old-school way.

name: uberasm-modern-starman-v1
title: Modern Starman V1.1
description:
This UberASM increases Mario's P-speed and reduces the amount of time required for P-speed while he has a Starman active. Check the asm file for customization options.

Note: Use this tweak to prevent a bug where Mario can rapidly turn while in an icy level.

yoshifanatic's update:
- Fixed an oversight where spin jumping/cape spinning causes Mario to rapidly alternate between moving left/right when he has P-speed.
- Fixed a bug where you could clip into walls while running with P-speed.
- Fixed a bug where you'd gain P-speed just by holding down X/Y without moving.
- Fixed a bug where you could fill your P-meter by running into a wall.
- Added checks to stop Mario from keeping his P-speed when climbing, ducking, swimming, stunned, sliding, and while using a P-balloon and lakitu cloud.
- Made it so the turning is not instant.
- Optimized the code a little.

name: uberasm-multi-step-autoscroll-v1
title: Multi-step Autoscroll V1.1
description:
This code allows you to create your own special autoscroll that goes where you want at the speed you want, much like the generator used in Butter Bridge 1 (level 00C) in the original game.

It works by using tables where you store X/Y speeds for each step of the autoscroll. It allows the use of fractional speeds and can be paused/resumed anytime you want using a flag. Plus, all the free RAM used can be easily changed to avoid conflicts, and the whole scrolling code can either stop or loop when it reaches the end of the tables.

UPDATE: You can now setup a custom code that will interrupt the autoscroll and be executed at certain points in time. This way, you force the player to progress only if a certain thing has been done.
Default code is the classic "advance if all sprites have been killed".

Details in .asm file.

yoshifanatic's update:
- Fixed a warning about LDA $XX,y not being a valid opcode when inserting this to non-SA-1 ROMs.
- Added mention of this patch in case users run into issues with sprites spawning.
- Made !ListLength automatic, so the user doesn't need to keep track of the size of the ignored sprite list.
- Fixed a bug where this runs during no Yoshi intros.
- Added throw blocks, Peach, the bonus game, winged cage, layer 3 smasher, side exit, ball n' chain, Bowser, wooden spikes, and Bowser statue to the list of ignored sprites.
- Fixed an oversight where the sprite check breaks when not using PIXI.
- Made various minor code optimizations.

name: uberasm-new-super-mario-bros-wii-styled-secret-passages
title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Secret Passages
description: This UberASM will hide layer 2 while Mario is near it, which can be used to reveal secret passages like how New Super Mario Bros. Wii handles its secret passages. You can either have the spotlight around Mario always active or only appear when a certain trigger is activated (such as $14AF).

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Secret Passages

name: uberasm-no-overworld-v1
title: No Overworld v1.3
description:
Originally inspired by a resource from Alcaro, and does pretty much the same thing: disables returning to overworld after beating levels and instead has the player go through levels in a sequence, either in numerical order or in an order defined by you.

Changelog
v1.3 (by AmperSam)
- made compatible with UberASM Tool 2.0
- dropped the 'global_code' instructions in favour of gamemode
- generally made the options and instructions more understandable and readable

v1.2
- Fixed crash with retry patch
- Fixed graphic issue when using "VWF intro 1.22"
- Fixed Player 2 compatiblity with "Exit Block (no OW events)" and "Door exit"
- More info for coders.txt

Thanks to Darolac for pointing some of these issues and testing.

v1.1
- Supports two players
- Secret exits(advanced mode)
- various fixes
- clean.asm is now integrated in NoOverworld.asm

name: uberasm-on-demand-reserve-powerup
title: On-Demand Reserve Powerup
description:
Allows the player to fill the reserve item box on the fly for a configurable currency (of lives, coins, or Dragon Coins) and rate. Which powerup given can be determined on a per-level basis with the extra byte.

Requested by bandicoot.
Requires UberASM 2.0 or higher.

Setting Powerup with the Extra Byte
: 01 gives a Mushroom
: 02 gives a Fire Flower
: 03 gives a Star*
: 04 gives a Cape Feather

*With the Star, be prepared to address the myriad of sprites that do not have proper kill frames.
Change Log (Revision A)
- Converted patch to UberASM. (Removed hijack, adapted labels.)
- Function is now operable in Bowser's fight.
- Powerup is now handled by the extra byte
- Prevented code from running while paused, dying, or otherwise frozen.
- Moved configurables higher up for visibility
- Added math for handling deduction of more than one life or Dragon Coin.
- Concurrent powerup sound is disabled by default.
- You can now prevent Mario from buying a powerup with Dragon Coins already redeemed for an extra life.

name: uberasm-one-time-flower
title: One Time Flower
description: An UberASM that allows you to shoot only once when you have a fire flower and makes Mario small again. It's a little customizable.

name: uberasm-pause-on-death-v1
title: Pause on Death V1.1
description:
Pause on Death - Freezes the game in place upon death before starting the death animation for a configurable amount of time, perhaps giving the player a chance to see what killed them in a hectic level.

Apply to gamemode 14 to make it universal or instead just apply it to specific level numbers if you only want it on certain levels.

yoshifanatic's update
- Made use of UberASMTool 2.0's end label to make this not need to run during V-Blank.
- Removed the gamemode version as the above change allows you to insert the same file as either level or gamemode ASM.
- Fixed an oversight where you could press select during the pause to exit the level if you've already beaten it.
- Made a few optimizations that saved 10 bytes overall.

name: uberasm-pay-coins-to-jump-v1
title: Pay Coins to Jump V1.1
description:
This UberASM code makes jumps expensive, using user-defined amount of coins. Also works for swimming.

Credit is optional.

V1.1 Update:
- Made this asar 2.0 compatible.
- Fixed a bug where jumping frame perfectly wouldn't cost any coins (note that you can still jump frame perfectly off Yoshi, which can't easily be fixed).
- Fixed a bug where pressing both jump buttons a frame apart would cost you 2x the coins.
- Prevented wasting coins if you attempt to jump in some states, like if you're stunned or using a P-balloon.
- Jumping off vines and while wall running now costs coins.

name: uberasm-peach-s-floating-ability
title: Peach's Floating Ability
description: This will give the player a floaty jump, similar to Peach's own in Super Mario Bros. 2.

name: uberasm-player-animated-tiles-exgfx-v1
title: Player + Animated Tiles ExGFX v1.2
description:
This UberASM allows you to insert different ExGFX files for GFX32 and 33 (player and animations GFX) on a sublevel, submap and cutscene basis. It's similar to the patch by Roy, but with a few key differences explained in the README. Mainly, it doesn't have issues on SA-1 (that I know of), and it should have faster loading times in some cases. Additionally you can also change GFX manually with code, if you want to go more advanced. Anyway, make sure to check the README for insertion instructions and whatnot.

v1.1:
- fixed GFX not changing when using a pipe/star warp on the Overworld
- now you can change the GFX on the title screen (using levels C7/1C7)

v1.2:
- made compatible with UberASM Tool 2.0+

name: uberasm-press-r-to-switch-characters-v1-1
title: Press R to Switch Characters V1.1.1
description:
Whenever you press the R button, you will switch between Mario and Luigi! Keep in mind that whenever you switch characters, you will have to switch controllers, too. Unless you make use of this tweak.

Includes options for allowing Mario and Luigi to have separate coin counts, powerups, and item boxes. Separate lives is possible too, but was not included as setting Luigi's starting lives correctly would require a hijack. Also includes a helper UberASM that prevents problems on the overworld if exiting a level as the other character.

Changelog
yoshifanatic's update:
- Made this compatible with UberASM Tool 2.0
- Added a check to prevent the R button from switching characters while the game is paused, you're in a No Yoshi intro, a message is displaying, or you're doing the goal walk.
- Added an option to give Mario and Luigi a separate item box.
- Made the button to press for the character switch configurable.
- Made it so L/R scrolling is not disabled.
- Included a helper UberASM that fixes a major problem that occurs on the overworld if you exit the level as a different character than the one you entered with.
- Optimized the code a bit.

versions.title: Press R to Switch Characters V1.1.1

name: uberasm-press-r-to-switch-mario-and-luigi-on-the-overworld-v1
title: Press R to Switch Mario and Luigi on the Overworld V1.1
description:
This will switch the player from Mario to Luigi and back when Pressing the R button on the overworld during a Single Player game while leaving the 2 Player option intact.

It will take Mario's Score, Bonus Stars, Powerups, Yoshi's, overworld position and completely allows you to swap players without any odd behaviors like some of the other versions of "Switch Characters" blocks or patches.

This will work with Smallhacker's Separate Player graphics patch to give Luigi separate graphics from Mario. Instructions in the UberASM.

Note: Does require a patch for asar that is included. It fixes the lives system so that you won't get weird behaviors when you get a game over as Luigi.

Changelog
yoshifanatic's update:
- Merged the lives.asm patch into the main UberASM's file so you don't need to apply the patch separately.
- Removed the 1control.asm file, because there is now a tweak that does the exact same thing and it's not required for this patch to function. In addition, that tweak is SA-1 compatible while this was not.
- Made the patch code properly remove itself when you unpatch it, instead of running the original code in free space.
- Added FastROM support to the patch.
- Changed the main label to end, which makes it so overworld Mario/Luigi don't visually update during the fade out.
- Fixed a minor visual quirk where Luigi does not lose his halo when selecting continue.
- Various minor optimizations.

versions.title: Press R to Switch Mario and Luigi on the Overworld V1.1

name: uberasm-punishment-for-getting-coins-or-score
title: Punishment For Getting Coins or Score
description:
This bit of code sets your score and number of coins to zero. If you collect any points or coins, an event will trigger (I've put in four: Warping the player to the screen exit, killing the player, hurting the player, or resetting the game).



You should probably not make collecting coins reset the game unless you're a real jerk.

versions.title: Punishment For Getting Coins or Score

name: uberasm-punishment-for-getting-lives
title: Punishment For Getting Lives
description:
A simple code to either hurt or kill the player whenever they collect lives by any means, be it 1-UP, 3-UP moons, enemy chains, etc. Requires 1 byte of free RAM.

Requested by MorrieTheMagpie.

name: uberasm-relative-layer-2-vertical-rise-fall-v1
title: Relative Layer 2 Vertical Rise/Fall V1.1
description:
This code auto-scrolls level (or background) layer 2 up or down relative to layer 1, which makes rising and falling layer 2 sections possible without taking away vertical camera freedom.

A couple notes:
-Lunar Magic 3.40+ can already autoscroll layer 2. However, you only get 12 options, while this gives you far more customization for how fast layer 2 moves.
-It must be assured that the player can never reach layer 2 scrolled past the area that has been placed in Lunar Magic, or glitchy tiles will appear. This works for the applications shown in the screenshots, as the layer 2 itself impedes the player from going further down (for the lava) or up (for the blocks). For rising layer 2, it is of interest to also account for Mario's death animation, as he falls down a fair amount when dying (the .asm file talks about this in more detail).

yoshifanatic's Update:
- Fixed the faulty no Yoshi intro check so pipe entrances don't break this UberASM.
- Made some minor optimizations.
- Made this disable vertical layer 2 scroll during level init as a convenience.
- Added functionality to customize how many subpixels layer 2 moves to allow for more precision.

name: uberasm-reset-level-on-falling-down-offscreen-v1
title: Reset Level on Falling Down Offscreen V1.1
description:
This UberASM works as Level and Game Mode 14 ASM. Instead of dying when falling offscreen, the level will restart as if you reentered it from the overworld.

Note: This doesn't work on level 24 unless you disable it's gimmick in Lunar Magic!

yoshifanatic's Update:
- Removed the SA-1 check because it's redundant as UberASM already does this.
- Added support for Lunar Magic 3.00's horizontal level modes.
- Added midpoint support, so this code can teleport you to the midpoint of a level if you have it.
- Significantly optimized the code for getting a teleport destination.

versions.title: Reset Level on Falling Down Offscreen V1.1

name: uberasm-retry-system
title: Retry System v2.0.3
description:
This is the modern Retry System that extends and improves the original patch by worldpeace. Its base features are the same as the old patch, but there's a lot of new functionalities and customizations available, which make it an useful tool also for projects where a retry system is not needed. Additionally, being implemented as an UberASM project, it features much less hijacks than the original patch, making it compatible with more resources. UberASM Tool version 2.1 or higher is required.

The main features implemented are:
- Level respawn on death without going to the Overworld (with prompt or instant)
- Customizable Retry prompt appearance (box/bar/minimal)
- Multiple midways per level
- Automatic midways when entering a sublevel
- Customizable sprite status bar that replaces the vanilla one
- Death counter
- Integrated save system to retain checkpoints and other things in SRAM
- Title screen death fix
- Counterbreak (state reset when respawning or going to the Overworld)
- Miscellaneous bug fixes

See Documentation for more details.

You can check out the repository here.

You can see the changelog here.

name: uberasm-slipping-sfx
title: Slipping SFX
description:
Adds a sound effect whenever Mario is slipping on a slippery surface, similarly to how it's done in Yoshi's Island.

Comes with a custom sound effect as well instructions on how to insert it.

name: uberasm-smb2-styled-charged-jump
title: SMB2-styled Charged Jump
description:
When this code is used, the player can charge a jump by ducking for several frames, until the point they start to flash. While flashing, they can perform a higher jump. The configuration can be applied to all player characters, to a specific character or can be RAM flag dependent. Details and example on how to set and use the code are found all within the ASM file.

Defines to allow charging while riding Yoshi, charged jump/spinjump heights, SFX for charge ready and how long the player should duck to trigger the charge, as well as other options, are included.

name: uberasm-tallying-score
title: Tallying Score
description:
This UberASM+Patch modifies the score counter so that score is tallied up over a duration of time, instead of being updated instantly. You can control whether the tally adds a fixed constant every frame, adds a fixed fraction, or a variable fraction that updates constantly based on the remaining score to tally. You can also specify the value or fraction that should be added, to control the average duration of the tally.

Requires a few small helper patches which are automatically applied with the UberASM code. See TallyingScore.asm for customization options and usage notes.

To be inserted as GM14 code or level code.

name: uberasm-teleport-when-dying-v1
title: Teleport When Dying V1.1
description:
Teleport When Dying V1.1

Description: It's a simple UberASM that does what the title says: you'll get teleported to another level or sub-level if the player dies.
Comes with a few options and defines for some customization.

Requested by isaix

name: uberasm-vertical-layer
title: Vertical Layer 2 Scroll
description:
This is essentially a recreation of the "Layer 2 Scroll" sprite (sprite EA) in UberASM form, with some improvements. Most notably, it now fully supports vertical scrolling in levels, and has full customization of the scrolling parameters.

Also compatible with the vanilla auto-scroll sprite out of the box, as well as LM's horizontal Layer 2 autoscroll if you tweak its RAM addresses slightly.

name: uberasm-wario-dash-v1
title: Wario Dash V1.1
description:
This UberASM code will give you the ability to dash like Wario in a Wario Land game I haven't played. See the readme for insertion details.

Original description:
An updated version of my Wario Dash patch. This version changes a few things to fix some bugs. You no longer gain star power while dashing, but a sliding effect is simulated. As such, make sure enemies you want to be able to be killed by the dash are able to be killed by sliding (you can use Tweaker or whatever to enable that).

yoshifanatic's Update:
- Made this main code by default to take advantage of UAT 2.0's ability to insert multiple UberASMs per level.
- Consolidated the two sets of checks to prevent the dash to save on ROM space.
- Fixed the hat shading on the Wario dash frame, added a small dash frame, and included the palette that was meant to come with these graphics.
- Fixed a bug where pausing and having a message on screen affected the dash timer.
- Fixed a bug where you could dash continuously when pressed against a wall.
- Fixed a bug where the sliding state is preserved after the dash ends until the cooldown finishes.
- Fixed a bug where having a cape would make you turn repeatedly while dashing if the button assigned to the dash was X/Y.
- Fixed a bug where the cape did not animate properly while doing a dash.
- Made the sound effect configurable.
- Added a toggle that enables air dashing.
- Made it so the dash is canceled when Mario's $71 state is non-zero, while wall running, while in a lakitu cloud, and during level end.

name: uberasm-wing-cap
title: Wing Cap
description:
MellyMellouange's old Wing Cap sprite, cleaned up, optimized, made LM3 compatible, bugfixed and converted to UberASM by Arinsu.

Gives the player the ability to fly: also includes an optional spinjump drill down and glide ability.

name: uberasm-x-ray-spotlight
title: X-Ray Spotlight
description:
This UberASM changes the spotlight sprite so instead of lighting up the area under it, it instead reveals layer 1 under it. Based on this level from my hack, MYSQ.

Note that this requires a small hijack to fix a visual bug that would occur on SA-1.

Requested by ILoveSMW.

name: uberasm-yoshi-wings-teleport-on-yoshi-mount
title: Yoshi Wings Teleport on Yoshi Mount
description:
This code will make the player get immediately teleported to the Yoshi wings stage when riding Yoshi. Might be best used with this patch.

Requested by Knight of Time.
